sloka: तस्मै रामो महातेजाः पूजामर्घ्यपुरोगमाम् ।ददौ कुशलमव्यग्रं प्रष्टुमेवोपचक्रमे ।। ७.१०३.९ ॥
transliteration: tasmai rāmo mahātejāḥ pūjāmarghyapurogamām ।dadau kuśalamavyagraṁ praṣṭumevopacakrame ।। 7.103.9 ॥

translations.english: The greatly effulgent Rama offered him honor, preceded by arghya, and calmly began to inquire about his well-being.
